meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 Benchling 的 Python 开发包或网页接口读取和操作你的实验室数据,比如 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列、样本库存、电子实验记录、工作流程任务,还能用 SQL 查数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求自动化处理 Benchling 上的实验室数据,比如序列注册、库存或实验记录等,或在使用 benchling-sdk / v2 API 时触发。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到 box_xyz789。
say.note: 执行库存容器转移操作。

say.text: 查询数据仓库里最近的实验结果,汇总成表格。
say.note: 用 SQL 访问 Data Warehouse 获取数据。

howto.what_en: With this skill installed, Claude can read and modify Benchling lab data—like DNA/RNA/protein sequences, inventory, ELN entries, and workflow tasks—via the benchling-sdk or the v2 API, and query the Data Warehouse with SQL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate Benchling lab data (e.g., registry sequences, inventory, or ELN entries) or when using benchling-sdk / the v2 API.

say_en.text: Query the Data Warehouse for recent experiment results and summarize them in a table.
say_en.note: Uses SQL to access Data Warehouse data.
